Upload up to 12 listing or walkthrough photos for a condition grade and a line-by-line repair estimate. Then tap Show after repairs and the AI shows what that space could look like fixed up, so your buyers can picture the ARV.

How it works

  1. Upload photosUp to 12 from the listing, the seller or your walkthrough.
  2. Get the repair budgetCondition grade, line items with low and high ranges, and red flags.
  3. Show after repairsPick a photo and get a before and after you can download and send.

What's included

Condition grade
Move-in ready, cosmetic, needs updating, major repairs or full gut.
Line-item repairs
Kitchen, baths, flooring, paint and more, each with a low and high range and the photo it came from.
Red flags
Ceiling stains, water damage, foundation cracks and other things to check.
What photos can't show
Roof, HVAC and the electrical panel, plus questions to ask on the walkthrough.
AI after-repair render
Keeps the same camera angle, layout, windows and roofline, with clean mid-range finishes a flipper would use. No added rooms or pools.
Before and after slider
Drag to compare, then download both side by side.
Labeled for sharing
Every download says "AI concept of possible repairs. Not the actual property."

Send the repair lines straight into the deal analyzer.

After-repair renders are AI concepts to help buyers picture a finished flip. They aren't the actual property or a promise of how it will turn out.

Questions

Still have questions?Talk to the founder for 15 minutes. We'll walk through how you'd use it.Hop on a call
Does the render change the house?

It's told to keep the structure exactly the same and only fix what a typical flip would: damage, paint, flooring, cabinets, roof shingles and landscaping. Like any AI image, check it before you share it.

Can I send it to buyers?

Yes. Download it with the label burned in and send it with your deal. Always present it as a concept, not the real property.
